messages.content: Hi, I'm Priya. I'm building a customer-support chatbot startup called HelpLoop. Our backend is Flask with Postgres, and the investor demo is on Nov 20.
Nice to meet you, Priya! HelpLoop sounds great. Good luck preparing for the Nov 20 investor demo.
My cofounder Rahul handles sales. He wants us to offer a free tier.
A free tier can drive adoption. You could cap it at 100 conversations a month.
Update: we switched the backend from Flask to FastAPI. Also Rahul said the investor demo moved to Nov 27.
Got it: FastAPI now, and the demo is on Nov 27.
We decided on pricing: $49 per month for the Pro plan.
Noted, the Pro plan is $49 per month.
From now on please keep code examples short, just the key lines, no full files.
Will do, I'll keep code examples to the key lines.
We keep hitting bug PG-1042 in production, it's a database connection pool timeout. Any ideas?
For PG-1042, try raising the pool timeout to 30 seconds and enabling pool_pre_ping=True so stale connections are detected.

distractor_sessions: My sister Ananya's college fest is on Nov 25, I promised I'd attend.
That sounds fun! Enjoy the fest on Nov 25.
A friend's startup, ChatNest, uses Django and charges $29 a month for their plan.
Interesting, Django is a solid choice for ChatNest.
Rahul took the team out for biryani today, he wants to make it a monthly thing.
Sounds like a nice team tradition!
I'm reading The Mom Test to get better at customer interviews.
Great pick, it's very practical for customer conversations.
